name: USSF-432
destination_explanation: Most of the satellites working today are down here, which has made this by far the most crowded stretch of space around the planet.
slot_a_text: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
slot_b_text: B1095 is out on its 8th flight. Recovery is 574 km downrange, on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You. Its previous trip was GPS III SV10, about 7 months ago.
